lines.text: Many learners say: I had him to fix my car.
Better: I had him fix my car.
Have someone do something. No to.
Help! I had my brother help me.

data.wrong: I had him to fix my car.
data.right: I had him fix my car.
data.why: Have someone do something. No to.
